title: Arise, Little Light
traveler_why: Scout is the seeker who gets up first to look, and tonight Isaiah calls a people sitting in the dark to arise and meet the light that has already come.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because a seeker is first up to meet the light. In Scout's world today: Scout wakes before anyone and finds the hallway grey and still. Instead of calling out, Scout tiptoes to the window to watch the sky turn pink at the bottom. When Mama comes, Scout whispers, 'It came back!' Just like the people told to arise and shine because their light had come, Scout learned that morning always keeps its promise.
